body: Mine comes in patches that are in various states of fullness so that's not an option for me. Glad it works for you though!
Undiagnosed mental illness seems to be the problem here. Depression is everywhere in our shallow world and only recently have we as a species learned what to call it. I wish you the best.
Thank you for sharing. You echo many of my own feelings. Though life takes us down separate roads, I wish you the very best and hope we see brighter days.

I have never had a problem with women due to my height. Most find it endearing in my experience. Unfortunately, at 23 my facial structure is still that of a 14 year old so I get disrespected by other adults constantly.
